why_intro: GCCM 2027 is more than a conference — it is a launchpad for your research, your clinical practice, and your next translational collaboration.
why_attend: Hear first on breakthrough findings across 14 scientific tracks in cardiology.
Keynote, plenary and invited speakers from leading US and international institutions.
Connect with researchers, clinicians and industry leaders across 12+ countries — in one room, over two days.
All accepted abstracts published in the ISBN-allocated proceedings; selected papers invited to partner journals.
Best Paper, Best Poster and Young Investigator awards with global visibility and certificates of excellence.
Two days of curated networking and a gala dinner — attend on-site in Barcelona or stream every session live, worldwide.
